description_en: Describes the syntax and provides examples of the EraseVideoLogo operation for video logo erasure
description_zh: 本文介绍视频标志擦除EraseVideoLogo的语法及示例
kebab_example: aliyun videoenhan erase-video-logo --video-url http://viapi-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/viapi-3.0domepic/videoenhan/EraseVideoLogo/EraseVideoLogo1.mp4 --boxes W=1.0 H=1.0 X=0.0 Y=0.0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: EraseVideoLogo

parameters.help_en: The URL of the video. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the Shanghai region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 视频URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: video_url

element_fields.help_en: The ratio of the logo region width to the video width. Valid values: 0 to 1
element_fields.help_zh: Logo区域宽度与视频宽度的占比值，取值0~1
element_fields.name: w

element_fields.help_en: The ratio of the logo region height to the video height. Valid values: 0 to 1
element_fields.help_zh: Logo区域高度与视频高度的占比值，取值0~1
element_fields.name: h

element_fields.help_en: The ratio of the y-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the logo region to the video height. Valid values: 0 to 1
element_fields.help_zh: Logo区域左上角点y坐标与视频高度的占比值，取值0~1
element_fields.name: y

element_fields.help_en: The ratio of the x-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the logo region to the video width. Valid values: 0 to 1
element_fields.help_zh: Logo区域左上角点x坐标与视频宽度的占比值，取值0~1
element_fields.name: x

parameters.help_en: The position information of the logo region
parameters.name: boxes
